audience: A 12th-grade graduate from India with limited English vocabulary, from a non-English-medium school, who wants to start a career in AI. Assume they start from zero.

must_cover.point: Retrieve: finding the most relevant pieces of text from a collection of documents
Augment: adding the retrieved text to the prompt together with the question
Generate: the LLM writes the answer using the retrieved text
Chunking: splitting documents into small pieces before storing them
Embeddings: turning text into lists of numbers that capture meaning
Similarity search: finding the chunks whose meaning is closest to the question (usually in a vector database)
At least one real-world use case of RAG
Limits of RAG (for example: bad retrieval gives bad answers, it can still make mistakes, limited context window)
RAG vs fine-tuning: RAG gives the model facts at answer time without changing it; fine-tuning trains and changes the model
